title: CI integration for slow tests
objective: Configure CI to run pytest -m slow on PRs touching codegen/ or solver/, ensuring E2E Taichi tests are exercised before merge.
implementation_steps: Add or extend a CI job that runs 'uv run pytest -m slow' on PRs touching codegen/ or solver/
Ensure slow tests are not run on every push (only on relevant PRs or nightly)
Register pytest markers (slow, gpu, e2e) in pyproject.toml to suppress warnings
Verify CI job triggers correctly on a test PR
deliverables: .github/workflows/ — updated or new CI job for slow tests
acceptance_criteria: CI runs slow tests on PRs touching codegen/ or solver/
Slow tests not run on unrelated PRs

cases: CI job triggers on codegen/ changes [missing]
CI job triggers on solver/ changes [missing]
CI job does not trigger on unrelated changes [missing]
Pytest marker warnings suppressed [covered - already in pyproject.toml]

commands: grep markers pyproject.toml -> slow, gpu, e2e registered
CI YAML validated: slow-tests job with path filtering
